• 33 reviews What's great actionable insights (1) clean design (4) audio transcription (4) HyNote AI feels like a product built for someone who actually works in knowledge-intensive roles. It's a full stack solution, meaning it doesn't just record meetings—it pulls from PDFs, screenshots, voice notes, video snippets, and weaves them all together into a unified note system. I tested it with a research workflow where I had meeting recordings, PDF whitepapers, and phone call audio all happening in a single project. What struck me was the cross-device sync. I took a note on my iPhone using voice during a commute, and by the time I opened my Mac, the note was there with a cleaned-up transcript and preliminary summary waiting. The clean, Apple Notes-like design is deceptively powerful—it doesn't show off, it just works. And the "chat with notes" capability is genuinely useful when you need to dig into research from three weeks ago without rewatching everything. What needs improvement Here's where I need to be direct: the payment experience is rough. One reviewer mentioned getting double-charged after accidentally clicking upgrade, and HyNote's refund process apparently pointed them to App Store links when they paid directly on the website. That's a customer service failure that should not happen, especially when dealing with billing. Beyond that, template options for business use are sparse. • 1 review What's great AI assistant (2) meeting recording (5) It makes it much easier to turn meetings and scattered work files into clear, actionable notes. The summaries are easy to scan and genuinely helpful for follow-ups. Speaker attribution can sometimes be inaccurate when several people talk over each other, and the free tier isn’t quite enough for the number of meetings on my calendar. Still, it’s an easy five stars! What needs improvement Speaker attribution could be more accurate when several people interrupt or talk over one another. I’d also appreciate a more generous or flexible free tier, as the current allowance runs out fairly quickly with a meeting-heavy calendar. • 11 reviews Terrible experience from start to finish. First, I paid on their website and wanted a refund. Used their own "get refund" option and they responded with App Store refund links - complete lie since I paid directly on their site, not through Apple. Spent time checking all my Apple accounts as they suggested - obviously found nothing since I never bought through the App Store. Went back to their website just to double-check payment options and clicked "upgrade" to see what was available. They immediately charged me AGAIN without any confirmation step. Now I'm out even more money for a service that wasn't good enough to keep in the first place. Their support team either can't read or deliberately misleads customers. The charging system is predatory - no confirmation, just instant payment when you're browsing. The app itself isn't worth the hassle anyway, which is why I wanted the original refund. Save yourself the headache and find something else. Customer service is dishonest and the payment system is designed to trick you. Read more Helpful (1) Share Report 323 views 1yr ago
